    'Rebecca': [(9 * 60 + 30, 10 * 60 + 30), (11 * 60, 11 * 60 + 30), (12 * 60, 12 * 60 + 30), (13 * 60, 17 * 60)],
    'Jordan': [(9 * 60, 9 * 60 + 30), (10 * 60, 11 * 60), (11 * 60 + 30, 12 * 60), (13 * 60, 15 * 60), (15 * 60 + 30, 16 * 60 + 30)]
}

for person in blocked_intervals:
